entities.name: Józef Pawlikowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Józef Pawlikowski was a Polish noble and political activist. One of the Polish Jacobins; secretary of Tadeusz Kościuszko in 1795 in France. An independence activist in Congress Poland, he was arrested in 1826 and died in prison in 1828.
